none.title: {game} has never had a season.
none.body: Create the first one with **New season**. It opens with no maps and no baselines, and you upload both here afterwards.

dates.note: Midnight UTC. It has no matches yet, so this changes no standing.

close.notLive: {season} is no longer live, or someone already asked to close it.
close.unsent: We could not send the request.
close.title: You cannot undo closing {season}.
close.body: The ratings settle and the {ladders} ladders become final. We cancel the queued matches.
close.bodyInFlight: The ratings settle and the {ladders} ladders become final. We cancel the queued matches and withdraw {versions} versions mid-trial.

maps.title: Maps

noneInPlay.title: No map is in play.
noneInPlay.body: Pairing waits until you switch one on.

maps.confirm: We cancel its queued matches, and running ones finish and count. You can switch it on again.
maps.empty: No maps yet. Drop the season’s map files below.

mapUpload.or: or pick them · .json · they land switched off
mapUpload.done: {n} added, switched off. Switch them on above to put them in play.

baselines.title: Baselines

noneInPlay.title: No baseline is in play.
noneInPlay.body: New versions play their trials against baselines, so each one waits until you switch a baseline on.

baselines.confirm: We cancel its queued matches, and running ones finish and count. It leaves the ladder with its rating, and you can switch it on again to put it back.
baselines.refusedTitleNoReason: Admission refused it: no reason given
baselines.empty: No baselines yet. Upload one below: a name and its two files.

baselineUpload.uploaded: You uploaded {name}, and admission is checking it. It lands switched off.
baselineUpload.failed: {file} did not upload: {reason}. Upload it again under the same name.
baselineUpload.noHashing: This browser cannot hash files here, because the page came over neither https nor localhost. Upload baselines through the API.
baselineUpload.name: Name: Scout, nano-bc

season.fallback: We could not save the season.

said.season_not_scheduled: That season opened after you loaded this page, and competitors are submitting to it, so you can no longer move its window.
said.season_name_unusable: That name leaves no slug: use letters or digits, and avoid current, live, latest and new.
said.season_slug_taken: Another season of this game already has that slug. Pick another name.
said.season_name_fixed: A season keeps its name and slug for good.
said.season_live: This game still has a live season, and a game takes submissions for one season at a time. Close that one first.
said.no_engine: This game has no active engine digest to pin the season to. Register the cartridge, then create the season.
said.inside_gap: The opening date is inside the minimum gap after the previous season closed. Move it later.
said.admin_only: This account does not administer seasons.

map.off: It is off; switch it on instead.
map.outsideLimits: {board} is outside what this game allows: {minPlayers}–{maxPlayers} seats, sides {minSide}–{maxSide}, at most {cells} cells.
map.outside: {board} is outside what this game allows.
map.idTaken: The season already has a map called {map}.{off}
map.idTakenUnnamed: The season already has a map called that.{off}
map.duplicate: The season already has this board, as {map}.{off}
map.duplicateUnnamed: The season already has this board, as another map.{off}

said.map_bad_header: Not a map file: it needs an id and whole-number players, rows and cols.
said.map_invalid: The engine refused it. `tinybrains maps check <file>` prints why.
said.engine_mismatch: This node runs a different engine from the season’s, so it cannot judge the board.
said.map_conflict: Another change got there first. Reload the list.

baseline.nameTesting: Admission is already checking {name} with other files. Wait for its verdict, or use another name.
baseline.nameTestingUnnamed: Admission is already checking a baseline by that name with other files. Wait for its verdict, or use another name.
baseline.nameTaken: This season already has {name}, and its model never changes within a season. Use another name.
baseline.nameTakenUnnamed: This season already has a baseline by that name, and its model never changes within a season. Use another name.
baseline.rejected: Admission refused it ({reason}). Upload it again under the same name.
baseline.rejectedNoReason: Admission refused it (no reason). Upload it again under the same name.

said.baseline_name_unusable: That name leaves no slug: use 1 to 48 characters with letters or digits.
said.hashes_required: Add both files: model.onnx and manifest.json.
said.baseline_conflict: Another upload of that name got there first. Reload the list.
said.baseline_admitting: Admission is still checking it; you can switch it on once it passes.
said.unknown_baseline: There is no such baseline in this season.
